listitem.para: EntityManagerFactoryBuilder - This service interface offers JPA clients the ability to create instances of EntityManagerFactory for a given named persistence unit.

section.title: public interface EntityManagerFactoryBuilder
section.para:
This service interface offers JPA clients the ability to create instances of EntityManagerFactory for a given named persistence unit. A service instance will be created for each named persistence unit and can be filtered by comparing the value of the osgi.unit.name property containing the persistence unit name.
This service is used specifically when the caller wants to pass in factory-scoped properties as arguments. If no properties are being used in the creation of the EntityManagerFactory then the basic EntityManagerFactory service should be used.

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public static final String JPA_CAPABILITY_NAME = "osgi.jpa"
section.para: The name of the JPA extender capability.

section.title: public static final String JPA_SPECIFICATION_VERSION = "1.1"
section.para: The version of the extender capability for the JPA Service specification

section.title: public static final String JPA_UNIT_NAME = "osgi.unit.name"
section.para: The name of the persistence unit.

section.title: public static final String JPA_UNIT_PROVIDER = "osgi.unit.provider"
section.para: The class name of the provider that registered the service and implements the JPA javax.persistence.PersistenceProvider interface.

section.title: public static final String JPA_UNIT_VERSION = "osgi.unit.version"
section.para: The version of the persistence unit bundle.

section.title: public EntityManagerFactory createEntityManagerFactory(Map<String, Object> props)

formalpara.title: props
formalpara.para: Properties to be used, in addition to those in the persistence descriptor, for configuring the EntityManagerFactory for the persistence unit.

section.para: Return an EntityManagerFactory instance configured according to the properties defined in the corresponding persistence descriptor, as well as the properties passed into the method.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An EntityManagerFactory for the persistence unit associated with this service. Must not be null.

section.title: public Bundle getPersistenceProviderBundle()
section.para: This method returns the Bundle which provides the PersistenceProvider implementation that is used by this EntityManagerFactoryBuilder.

If the PersistenceProvider is provided as an OSGi service then this method must return the bundle which registered the service. Otherwise this method must return the bundle which loaded the PersistenceProvider implementation class.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The Bundle which provides the PersistenceProvider implementation used by this EntityManagerFactoryBuilder.

section.title: public String getPersistenceProviderName()
section.para: This method returns the name of the PersistenceProvider implementation that is used by this EntityManagerFactoryBuilder. The returned value will be the same as the value of the JPA_UNIT_PROVIDER service property.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the name of the PersistenceProvider implementation
